_comment: Glimmerline's hosted remote config (launch state, 2026-11-08): ads_enabled false until an ad network confirms the studio's account — the Ads SDK is never initialized, no interstitial or rewarded ads, the Store hides the Ad-Free passes, analytics follow the consent regime by region. ads_network stays "max" so the flip to ads is one value: set ads_enabled to true after the AppLovin key and ad units are in the shipped build's secrets and the device pass in MAX test mode is done; push the site repo; every install picks it up on the launch after the one that fetches it (GitHub Pages caches about ten minutes). ads_network "admob" selects the AdMob path if that account is ever approved; "none" is the explicit no-ads path. Same shape as config/remote_defaults.json, which is the fallback when this file is unreachable.
